SPLIT OUT. This bead's headline figures did not reproduce, but its stated suspicion - 'per-call recomputation of plan/fit-invariant work (residual factorization, contrasts, validation)' - was correct, and I have now quantified it on real data with 3192 profile samples over 60 calls: .require_relation_fit_capability and relation_fit_capabilities are 53 percent of every call, .validate_relation a further 18 percent, and signature recomputation (serialize, deparse, digest, .additive_frame_signature) visible throughout. Steady-state per-call cost is 0.106 s.

So the cost you suspected is real and is validation specifically, not residual work. Filed as its own bead so it survives whatever disposition this one gets, since this one rests on a 9 s/node figure I could not reproduce and that one rests on a measurement I could.
